insight: Maker Zhipu's January 2026 Hong Kong IPO ($558M at a $7.1B valuation) made it the world's first publicly traded foundation-model company.
name: Z.ai
tagline: Zhipu's GLM assistant — frontier open-weight chat, free to use.
description: Z.ai is the international assistant of Zhipu AI, built on the GLM model family. The free chat runs the flagship GLM-5 and GLM-5.1 models with reasoning and agentic modes, and the same models are served to developers over a low-cost, OpenAI-compatible API. GLM-5's open weights ship under the MIT license.

modelSupport.notes: Zhipu's GLM family; GLM-5 weights are MIT-licensed.

edge: GLM-5 benchmarks near Claude Opus-class models at roughly 5–8x lower API price, and its weights are MIT-licensed for self-hosting.
cons: English UX less polished than rivals

references.title: GLM-5: China's First Public AI Company Ships a Frontier Model
